description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 2022 Order under Subsection (2) of Section 1
categorisation: This gazette content announces the commencement date of the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 2022. It is a legal/regulatory matter involving the implementation of amended legislation, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a government personnel change, so government types (1-3) do not apply.
